title: Blackstone (BX) Joins $3 Billion Debt Deal As It Readies Hotel IPO
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 加入 30 亿美元债务交易，准备酒店 IPO
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) joined Waymo’s first major debt financing, a US$3b deal that marks the autonomous driving company’s debut in the debt market.
summary_zh: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 加入了 Waymo 的首笔重大债务融资，这笔 30 亿美元的交易标志着这家自动驾驶公司首次在债务市场上亮相。

title: Elon Musk Touts a ‘Storm’ of Tesla Cybercabs in Austin, Says They Offer Better ‘Operational Efficiency’ Than Waymo
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在奥斯汀吹捧特斯拉 Cyber​​cab 的“风暴”，称它们提供比 Waymo 更好的“运营效率”
summary: Tesla Inc. CEO Elon Musk has backed the Cybercab ahead of its launch event in Austin, Texas, as the EV maker looks to expand its Robotaxi network. A Storm Of Cybercabs In a post on X in the early hours...
summary_zh: 特斯拉公司首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 Cyber​​cab 在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的发布会之前表示支持，该电动汽车制造商希望扩大其 Robotaxi 网络。一场网络出租车风暴 在凌晨 X 上的一篇帖子中……

title: Waymo raises $3 billion in first-ever debt deal with Pimco, Blackstone
title_zh: Waymo 通过与 Pimco 和 Blackstone 的首笔债务交易筹集了 30 亿美元
summary: The Alphabet unit is working with Goldman Sachs to finalize the loan, which could price at more than 500 basis points over the benchmark
summary_zh: Alphabet 部门正在与高盛合作敲定这笔贷款，贷款定价可能比基准高出 500 个基点以上

title: Lilly’s Merida Deal Shows the GLP-1 King Is Already Thinking Beyond Obesity
title_zh: 礼来公司与 Merida 的交易表明 GLP-1 之王已经开始超越肥胖的思考
summary: Eli Lilly's $2.875 billion Merida Biosciences deal expands its immunology pipeline, as strong GLP-1 growth continues while LLY shares trail the broader health care sector.
summary_zh: 礼来 (Eli Lilly) 价值 28.75 亿美元的 Merida Biosciences 交易扩大了其免疫学产品线，GLP-1 继续强劲增长，而 LLY 股价落后于更广泛的医疗保健行业。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
